title: Reject negative minutes
prompt: Checked(int minutes) should return minutes unchanged when it is 0 or more, and throw an ArgumentException when it is negative. The starter returns every input.
hints: Which inputs are acceptable? Is 0 one of them?
Test for the bad input first, and throw before the return.
If minutes is less than 0, throw new ArgumentException with a short message. Otherwise return minutes.
checkLabels: A negative number must throw an ArgumentException.
0 is acceptable and must not throw.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Throws the general Exception type instead of the specific one.

feedback: Check the type of exception you throw and the exact edge: -1 must throw and 0 must not.
